panels.title: Do users experience it as slow? TTFT p50 and p95 (measured by client-side prober, not reported by the engine)
Are we about to saturate? requests waiting and running

options.content:
**Prefix cache hit rate** and **KV cache utilisation** are vLLM metrics and arrive in phase 2. llama.cpp does not emit the KV cache events these depend on. See `docs/adr/0006-metric-normalisation.md`. This panel is deliberately text: an empty graph is indistinguishable from a broken one.

The TTFT panel above is not this engine's own signal either: it comes from a client-side prober CronJob (`platform/30-observability/ttft-prober-cronjob.yaml`), because llama.cpp exposes no latency histogram of any kind. It is labelled in its own title for the same reason - a synthetic number must never look like a served one.
